opinions.feedback: All test cases are well-grounded, executable, distinct, and directly map to the supplied requirements without any blockers or contradictions.
The test cases G-002 and G-003 rely on an external visual reference ('as in the given image') which is not provided, making the expected behavior unverifiable and ambiguous.
confirmed_blockers: Requirement R-176 and case G-002 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display untestable.
Requirement R-177 and case G-003 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display untestable.

opinions.feedback: Evidence is inconclusive for a blocker assessment as no cases are provided for R-176 and R-177.
Two requirements (R-176 and R-177) regarding theme image displays are not covered by any test cases, and the test cases for visual rendering/images cannot be fully verified without the image assets.
confirmed_blockers: R-176 and R-177 lack test cases to verify their display requirements.

analysis.analysis: Based on the validator feedback, requirements R-176 and R-177 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display unverifiable. Consequently, these visual verification scenarios cannot be reliably formulated or tested as structured test cases under the current constraints.

opinions.feedback: Evidence is insufficient to confirm any blockers as the supplied cases cover the testable requirements and no concrete contradictions or untestable scenarios are present in the cases G-001 through G-005.

Cases G-001 through G-005 are properly grounded in their respective requirements. However, requirements R-176 and R-177 lack test cases, and no test cases verify the display of themes against images. Blocker assessment is incomplete due to missing coverage.
confirmed_blockers: Requirements R-176 and R-177 are missing test cases to verify that Classic and Modern themes are displayed as in the given images.

analysis.analysis: Based on the validator feedback, requirements R-176 and R-177 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display unverifiable. Consequently, scenarios associated with R-176 and R-177 cannot be effectively tested against a concrete visual specification without the missing assets.

opinions.feedback: The provided cases lack test coverage for R-176 and R-177, which require visual verification of the Classic and Modern themes against given images. Revision is requested to add cases covering R-176 and R-177.
confirmed_blockers: Requirements R-176 and R-177 are missing test case coverage.

analysis.analysis: Based on the validator feedback, requirements R-176 and R-177 depend on an external image reference that is not supplied, making the expected visual display untestable. All other requirements R-175, R-178, R-179, R-180, and R-181 remain valid and testable.

qualitative.rationale: The accepted state covers all 7 requirements (R-175 through R-181), whereas all candidates drop test cases for R-176 and R-177, reducing requirement coverage from 7 to 5. Although the accepted state has potential verification notes regarding missing image references, dropping test cases entirely is an objective regression in requirement coverage. Therefore, the accepted state remains preferred over all candidates.
